name: Dynamic Workflows
description: Run model-authored JavaScript workflow coordinators that fan out daemon-backed subagents.

tools.name: workflow
tools.title: Dynamic Workflow
tools.description: Run a JavaScript workflow coordinator that can spawn daemon-backed subagents. The script is the body of an async function, not an async IIFE or module. Use workflow.agent(...) for subagents and workflow.finish(result) for output.
tools.promptSnippet: Use workflow for large tasks that benefit from parallel subagents, verification, or long-running orchestration. The script field is an async function body; call workflow.agent(...) and return workflow.finish({ summary, findings, counts }) with a compact final result.
promptGuidelines: Pass JavaScript statements for the body of an async function. Do not wrap the script in (async () => ...)(), module.exports, or export default.
Do not call workflow with only args/agentDefaults/cwd; args is data for the script, not the workflow body.
Omit waitForCompletion for normal tool use so long-running workflows return a workflow id and continue in the background; set it true only for short smoke checks.
Call workflow.phase, workflow.agent, workflow.map, workflow.log, and workflow.finish through the workflow global; do not use a bare agent() function.
Call return workflow.finish(result) or return a value from the script body so the tool result is not empty.
Use workflow.agent({ prompt, model?, allowedTools? }) for real work; the workflow script itself does not have filesystem or shell access.
Return a compact final result with summary/counts/key findings. Do not return every raw subagent result; raw node details are stored in the Workflows page.
Use workflow.map(items, async (item) => workflow.agent(...)) for fanout; workflow.agent calls are concurrency-capped by settings.
Prefer cheaper models for broad fanout when appropriate, for example opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash.

script.description: JavaScript statements for the body of an async function. Example: await workflow.phase('test'); const r = await workflow.agent({ prompt: '...' }); return workflow.finish({ summary: r.summary, runId: r.runId });

waitForCompletion.description: Normally omit this so tool-invoked workflows start durably and return immediately. Set true only for short workflows that should block until complete.

skills.title: Dynamic Workflows
skills.description: Built-in guidance for using the workflow tool to orchestrate phases, logs, and daemon-backed subagents.

dynamicWorkflows.defaultAgentModel.description: Default model for workflow-spawned subagents, for example opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash.

dynamicWorkflows.defaultAgentAllowedTool.description: Default tool names for workflow subagents.

dynamicWorkflows.maxConcurrentAgents.description: Maximum workflow subagents running at the same time.

dynamicWorkflows.maxTotalAgents.description: Maximum subagents a workflow may spawn.

dynamicWorkflows.workflowTimeoutMinutes.description: Timeout for the whole workflow run.
